name: delegate_task
description: Spawn isolated subagents for parallel or context-heavy work; each gets its own conversation, terminal and toolset, and only its final summary returns (joined: results come back in this call). Pass every task in `tasks`: one entry = one subagent, several run in parallel. Use for reasoning-heavy subtasks, work that would flood your context, independent workstreams; not for mechanical steps (use terminal), a single tool call, anything needing the user (children cannot ask questions) or durable work that must outlive the session (terminal background). Children know nothing of this conversation: put everything needed in `context` (also any required language or tone). Summaries are SELF-REPORTS: verify external side effects (uploads, remote writes) through a URL, ID or path before telling the user. Children cannot call delegate_task, clarify or memory, and inherit your model. Details: skill_view hermes-tools-guide

goal.description: What the subagent should accomplish: specific and self-contained; it knows nothing of your conversation.

context.description: Background THIS child needs: file paths, error messages, constraints. Each child sees only its own context: repeat shared background in every task.

tasks.description: The task(s), run in parallel (how many at once follows the user's budget profile: a longer list is refused and the error states the limit). Each entry = one subagent.
